show.title: Soulection Radio Show #146
show.content:
Joe Kay hits hard with 3 hours of HEAVY tracks on 1 hour of sleep

<!--more-->


There is something for everybody in here. Lots of unreleased music + music that was forgotten about. Shouts to all the amazing people who tuned in to the live show. Every once in a while we like to make a post about the location of our radio listeners and it's always inspiring to see how many people are actually tuning in and the locations that they reside in. We can't even pronounce some of the cities/countries! Talk about worldwide. Lets keep it moving.


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #157
show.content:
Joe Kay drops a 60 minute set of some stand out selects that he either just discovered, was holding onto, and rediscovered. 

<!--more-->
We played back a few cuts from last week such as the intro track by Yung Gud! God this track is a bad one even Sango is opening up with it at his recent shows.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #161
show.content:
Joe focuses on new tracks from forthcoming Soulection releases.

<!--more-->

Joe also announced some hints about what to expect in the coming months. We have so much in store for you. 
We're only a couple of weeks in to the new year and already we feel like we have hit some milestones. 

Stay tuned. 



Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.
